title: Sr. Clinical Study Manager
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Position Scope:**
-------------------


The mission of the Clinical Affairs group within Medical and Scientific Affairs is to create customer value for ImmunoDiagnostic Division (IDD) by providing clinical evidence for product pre\-launch and post\-launch across the portfolio. Main responsibilities for the unit are:

* Own IDD Clinical Affairs planning, execution, and reporting.
* Develop timely and efficient clinical strategies to support product claims (mainly autoimmunity portfolio).
* Liaise with Regulatory Affairs organization to complete prioritized product registration plans in selected geographical areas (USA and EU.
* Liaise with the Medical Directors to align disease definition and study population characterizations
* Liaise with R\&D organization to align product specifications to be fulfilled and patient cohorts to be targeted.
* Liaise with Commercial Operations organizations to ensure desired products are available for sales on the territory.
* Liaise with Marketing organization to leverage on key customers and KOLs within clinical trials and support building sales supporting arguments on top of registration\-related claims.

**Essential Responsibilities:**
-------------------------------


Reporting to the Global Director Clinical Affairs, the Senior Clinical Project Manager will be responsible for:

* Lead cross\-functional, high\-complex and business critical clinical projects.
* Hold accountability and responsibility of all operational and safety deliverables of assigned company sponsored studies.
* Develop relevant clinical strategies and plans.
* Ensure clinical research programs are designed and conducted in accordance with company standards operating policies \& procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practices (GCP), ISO20916:2019, In\-Vitro Diagnostics Device Regulation (IVDR) and FDA regulation.
* Generate clinical evaluation plans and reports for FDA and IVDR submissions.
* Generate relevant Trial Master File documents and support CRAs for TMF quality checks and completeness.
* Be able to build a CRF (Case Report Form) starting from the clinical study plan and protocol/s
* Generate CPSP (Clinical performance study plan) according to the study needs and in collaboration with several projects’ functions
* Support CRAs during clinical study initiation and close out.
* Identify project risks and develop \& implement mitigation plans.
* Organize, plan, and lead cross\-functional, highly sophisticated and business\-critical projects, with a focus on development, registration, and commercialization of Immunodiagnostic products.
* Guaranty Audit and Inspection preparedness of all assigned projects.
* Be responsible for corrective action plans at individual sites and across trial.
* Report project progress to governance boards and raise issues to IDD management.
* Provide decision support and recommendations for critical decisions to IDD management.
* Help identify and drive assigned department goals.

**Knowledge, Skill, and Ability:**
----------------------------------

* Demonstrate Leadership to develop, empower and guide personnel to meet objectives.
* Excellent interpersonal written and verbal skills to communicate optimally across cross\-functional departments and cross\-sites.
* Proficient knowledge of medical terminology, clinical trial design and statistics.
* Proven detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and international regulations and practices (knowledge of CE IVDR required and IVD FDA/CFDA strong asset).
* Expertise with ISO20916:2019 required.
* Knowledge of immunology, auto\-immunity and/or allergy strongly preferred.
* Ability to develop and implement solutions to address identified problems.
* Excellent project management, organizational and time management skills.
* Willingness and ability to travel oversea for up to 30\-50% of time.
* Ability to work in a diverse team and dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Ability to provide clear directions and guidance to others.
* Desire to use experience to build innovative infrastructure and “standard processes”.
* Knowledge of a Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) and skill in using Microsoft Office suite.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in biological sciences, nursing or related medical/scientific field or equivalent work experience.
* 5 years minimum preferred global clinical studies experience (in\-vitro medical devices experience preferred) with a minimum specifically in project management.
* Advanced written and spoken English and additional European language preferred.

**The Opportunity**


In this role, you will serve as the primary regulatory representative for Italy, ensuring compliance with local regulations, leading interactions with Health Authorities, and supporting product registrations and lifecycle management activities. You will work closely with regional regulatory teams, commercial operations, and external stakeholders to drive regulatory excellence and business success.


**The Role**


* Provide local regulatory expertise and input to support the development and execution of regulatory strategies for new product registrations and lifecycle management activities.
* Review promotional materials and provide regulatory guidance to ensure compliance with local regulations.
* Monitor and communicate progress of regulatory projects to relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with Italian regulatory requirements and evolving legislation.
* Support audit and inspection readiness activities and ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).
* Monitor changes in the regulatory landscape and communicate emerging requirements and industry trends to internal stakeholders.
* Participate in regulatory meetings, industry forums, and trade associations to represent company interests and share insights.
* Maintain compliance\-related KPIs and ensure regulatory information systems (RIMS) remain accurate and up to date.
* Serve as the primary contact for Italian Health Authorities and regulatory stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Health Authorities, industry groups, and trade associations.
* Lead local regulatory interactions related to licenses, submissions, and market access initiatives.
* Act as the regulatory representative for local Commercial Operations, providing strategic guidance and business\-focused regulatory support.
* Coordinate and prepare country\-specific regulatory documentation, including Module 1 and other local requirements.
* Support regional regulatory teams in submission planning and execution aligned with local requirements and business priorities.
* Track and communicate the status of regulatory submissions with local Health Authorities.
* Ensure regulatory compliance of product labeling, including SmPC, PIL, and packaging materials.
* Manage translation activities and required labeling updates.

**Your Skills and Experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline such as Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
* Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a scientific, healthcare, legal, or regulatory discipline preferred.
* Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) or other relevant professional certification is desirable.
* 3\-5\+ years of regulatory affairs experience in a Health Authority\-facing role within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry.
* Strong knowledge of Italian regulatory requirements and regulatory processes.
* In\-depth experience managing local Health Authority interactions.
* Experience managing regulatory submissions and product lifecycle activities.
* Demonstrated project management and cross\-functional leadership experience.
* Experience collaborating with commercial and business stakeholders in a matrix environment.
* Ability to adapt and perform effectively in a rapidly changing environment.
* Fluency in Italian and English, both written and spoken.
* Strong understanding of local health authority interactions and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global teams.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to escalate issues appropriately.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to thrive in a complex global matrix organization.

**What we offer**


We offer an open\-ended contract (Tempo Indeterminato) regulated by the CCNL Chimico Farmaceutico, with a gross annual salary range of €45,000 \- €55,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications. In addition, we provide an outstanding benefits package, an annual merit\-based reward process, and an individual development plan to support your professional growth and career progression.


**About CSL Behring**
---------------------



CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients' needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.


CSL Behring operates one of the world's largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.


To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/.

----------------



For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well\-being \| CSL.



**You Belong at CSL**
---------------------



At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.


To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion\-and\-belonging

title: Radwaste Worksite Senior Supervisor | Ispra, Varese
description:
***Building a sustainable future, together.***


At WSP, we design the future of our communities. As one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms, we bring together expertise across transport and infrastructure, buildings, energy, environment, water and advisory. In Italy, we combine local knowledge with international reach to deliver projects that create a positive, lasting impact for clients, communities and the environment.  

  

We are growing our Nuclear Decommissioning and Waste Management capability and are looking for a Radwaste Worksite Senior Supervisor to support activities connected to a nuclear decommissioning programme in Ispra. The programme involves the safe decommissioning of nuclear installations and the management of associated radioactive waste.

**The opportunity**


This is a unique opportunity to contribute to one of the most relevant nuclear decommissioning programmes in Italy, supporting onsite activities related to radioactive waste management at the client site in Ispra.


This role requires strong autonomy in defining operational strategies, guiding practical solutions and supporting onsite teams in a highly regulated technical environment.

**How you will make an impact**


Your work will support the correct management of radioactive waste generated by decommissioning activities, with a focus on technical strategy, senior\-level worksite supervision, documentation and daily coordination with project stakeholders.

* Lead the identification of strategies and the implementation of practical solutions for radioactive waste management onsite.
* Provide senior\-level worksite supervision, ensuring activities are aligned with project requirements, safety expectations and technical standards.
* Apply and interpret nuclear safety, radiation protection, radioactive waste classification and relevant regulatory requirements, including the Italian framework.
* Review technical documentation, QA/QC records, status updates and supporting project materials.
* Provide clear daily reporting to the Project Manager on onsite progress, technical issues, risks, decisions and next steps.
* Collaborate with client technical teams, WSP colleagues, contractors and other project stakeholders in a senior client\-facing technical role.

**The team around you**


You will be employed by WSP and work full\-time on\-site at the client site in Ispra, as part of a wider programme dedicated to nuclear decommissioning and waste management. You will collaborate closely with client technical stakeholders while remaining fully part of WSP, with ongoing internal support, coordination and access to wider technical expertise.


The working environment is technical, hands\-on and client\-facing, with activities taking place both in office settings and in the field. This is not only a client assignment: it is part of WSP’s growth in nuclear services, offering exposure to a specialized sector, international knowledge\-sharing and the opportunity to contribute to safe, compliant and practical decommissioning work.


As some activities may be performed in classified areas, personnel assigned to this role will be designated as professionally exposed. This will be further discussed during the interview process.

**What you will bring to the role**


We are looking for a senior professional with a strong nuclear background, proven technical judgement and the ability to guide practical decisions in a regulated onsite environment.

* Master’s degree, preferably in Nuclear Engineering, or in Energy, Mechanical, Civil, Environmental Engineering or Physics with documented nuclear training.
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in radioactive waste management, nuclear activities or nuclear decommissioning.
* Strong knowledge of nuclear safety, radiation protection, radioactive waste classification and radioactive waste management.
* Experience defining technical strategies and implementing practical solutions in complex nuclear or decommissioning environments.
* Availability to work full\-time onsite in Ispra, with the ability to operate effectively in a client\-facing technical environment.
* Fluency in English and Italian is required.
* Experience with MS Project or Primavera, Microsoft Office, STRIMS, technical documentation and QA/QC processes would be valuable.


We are looking for someone who can bring senior technical judgement, guide others through complex onsite situations and help strengthen WSP’s growing capability in nuclear decommissioning and radioactive waste management.

**Life at WSP**


When our people thrive, our projects thrive. At WSP, you will be supported to build your career, take on meaningful challenges and learn from talented professionals across a global network. This role offers the chance to contribute to a highly specialized programme in Italy while remaining connected to WSP’s broader technical community.

**Compensation and benefits**


WSP is committed to pay transparency. The annual gross salary for this position starts from **€43,000**, with the final offer determined based on the successful candidate’s experience, qualifications, technical expertise and alignment with the role requirements. In addition to base salary, we offer a benefits package and opportunities for professional development.

**Our partnership approach**


We see recruitment as a two\-way conversation. Our process is designed to be transparent, collaborative and respectful of your time. For this role, the process is expected to include:

* **Introductory conversation**: A first conversation with Talent Acquisition to discuss your experience, availability, salary expectations and work authorization.
* **Technical interview**: A discussion with the hiring manager to explore your nuclear background, worksite experience and senior\-level technical fit for the programme.
* **Client interview:** A further conversation with client stakeholders before final confirmation.

**Come as you are**


We are building teams that reflect the diverse communities we serve. For this specific role, some requirements are essential due to the technical, regulated and onsite nature of the work. If your background is relevant but you are not sure whether you meet every point, we still encourage you to apply.


All applications will be treated with confidentiality and considered under equal opportunities principles.

**Ready to help shape what’s next?**


If you are looking for a senior role where you can contribute to a highly specialised nuclear decommissioning programme and make a practical onsite impact, we would love to hear from you.


Apply now and discover what you can achieve with WSP.

**Accessibility and adjustments**


We want our recruitment process to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the process, please let us know so we can support you.

This role offers:



* **Real influence:** you will report directly to the CEO and play an important role in organizational and financial decisions.

**Overview**  

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will demonstrate expertise in standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment, as well as a holistic understanding of the functions of, and interactions between, network and server equipment. You will provide input for suggested modifications to these processes and procedures as needed to improve service quality and efficiency while providing guidance to other technicians.

  

You may be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.

  

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations \& Innovation (CO\+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO\+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO\+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity \& Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

  

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

  

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever\-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world\-class cloud provider.

  

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
* Performs post\-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
* Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
* Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.
* Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
* Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands\-on experience and relevant on\-the\-job training.

* Embodies our culture and values.

* Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.

Grazie alle recenti acquisizioni di Juice, Rekordata, Med Computer, Med Innovations e ICT, avvenuta nel 2024, **R\-Store** è oggi il principale partner Apple in Italia e tra i più rilevanti al mondo. Con headquarter a Napoli e una presenza in 18 regioni, l’azienda conta 100 negozi, 900 collaboratori e un fatturato di 600 milioni di euro. Oltre al canale retail consumer, supportato da personale altamente qualificato, R\-Store offre soluzioni su misura per aziende, scuole, università e pubblica amministrazione, garantendo un servizio post\-vendita completo come Centro di Assistenza Autorizzato Apple. Dal 2022 il gruppo ha diversificato il business entrando nei settori della Cyber Security e dei dispositivi ricondizionati, fino ad approdare nel 2024 al mondo della fotografia d'autore con l'apertura del primo Leica Store a Napoli



Posizione



In ambito Retail (Vendita, Service, Customer Relation) cerchiamo Apple Sales Specialist per il nostro punto vendita di **Milano\- Valtellina.**


**Cosa farai:**


* Accoglierai ogni cliente con un approccio consulenziale, trasformando ogni interazione in un’esperienza significativa.
* Capirai i bisogni, proporrai soluzioni integrate – prodotti, accessori, protezioni, servizi finanziari e noleggio operativo.
* Cura dell'esposizione dei prodotti nella show room secondo il planogramma schema espositivo) e relativi aggiornamenti, previsti da Apple e da R\-Store.
* Aggiornamento e corretta esposizione del materiale di merchandising.
* Ti relazionerai anche con clienti business e professionisti, offrendo soluzioni su misura grazie alla collaborazione con Rekordata, la società del gruppo dedicata al mondo aziendale
* Ti formerai continuamente grazie alla nostra Academy e ai programmi ufficiali Apple, per diventare un vero esperto della Customer Experience.
* Primo supporto nella risoluzione di problematica di utilizzo dispositivi Apple.


Requisiti


**Chi cerchiamo?**


* Persone curiose con passione per la tecnologia e soprattutto del mondo Apple
* Capacità di ascolto, empatia e orientamento al risultato.
* Esperienza in ambito Retail e preferibilmente nell’elettronica di consumo.
* Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.


Altre informazioni


**Cosa offriamo:**


* Retribuzione fissa (RAL) e bonus mensile fino al 30%, legato a obiettivi chiari misurabili.
* Crescita professionale in un’azienda solida, in espansione e con valori condivisi.
* Un sistema di incentivazione meritocratico basato su risultati misurabili.
* Percorsi di formazione certificata Apple, con sviluppo di competenze su vendita consulenziale, comunicazione e customer experience.
* Opportunità di crescita reale all’interno del gruppo R\-Store, sia nel canale retail che in aree specialistiche come business, education e digital solutions.
* Inquadramento: RAL: 23\.000 \- 25\.000 \- 5/ 4 livello CCNL Commercio e Terziario

**Perché R\-Store**



R\-Store come principale Premium Partner del brand, è a capo di un ecosistema strategico che unisce eccellenze complementari: Rekordata, che trasforma il business con soluzioni tecnologiche su misura, e Clever, il cuore green del gruppo dedicato ai prodotti ricondizionati e alla sostenibilità.



Inoltre, entrerai a far parte di un ambiente in cui le persone rappresentano il valore più importante. Crediamo che il successo di ogni progetto, decisione e innovazione nasca dal contributo di chi lo rende possibile ogni giorno. Per questo mettiamo collaboratori, clienti e partner al centro di ogni processo, valorizzandone competenze, idee e potenziale. In R\-Store promuoviamo una cultura basata sull’ascolto, sulla collaborazione e sulla crescita reciproca, perché siamo convinti che siano le persone a fare davvero la differenza.

* Analizzare i requisiti funzionali e tecnici espressi dai clienti.
* Collaborare con il team Sales nelle attività di prevendita, identificando la soluzione tecnologica più adatta alle esigenze del cliente.

description:
**Job Posting Title**


Digital Analytics \& Web Performance Specialist**The challenge**


An exciting opportunity has arisen to contribute to Haier Europe. The Company is on a journey to achieve ambitious growth and leadership objectives in the region, and we are seeking someone passionate, proactive, self\-driven, and motivated to join a team of open\-minded individuals. We are looking for someone who embodies the Company’s core behaviors, based on our Own It model : Zero Distance, Agility, Entrepreneurship, Ecosystem and Build Trust. A true change agent who acts with integrity, collaborates across boundaries, adapts quickly, takes initiative and keeps users at the center — fostering an open, innovative, and high\-performing environment.**What you will do**


As Digital Analytics \& Web Performance Specialist, you will be the go\-to person for digital performance analysis at HQ level and for operational support to local markets. You will have full ownership of the CRO and A/B testing platforms adopted by the company, independently managing vendor relationships, account configuration and day\-to\-day analytical support to internal stakeholders. Your work will have a direct impact on the optimization of the user experience across the Group's websites and on the effectiveness of each market's digital strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Data Analysis \& Stakeholder Support*

* Collect, interpret and respond to analysis requests from local markets, acting as the dedicated point of contact for all Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)\-related needs.
* Produce advanced reports and custom dashboards to monitor digital KPIs, traffic trends, user behavior and website performance, tailoring outputs to each market's needs.
* Manage CRM analytics, campaigns results and revenues contributions, integrating data across the funnel.
* Proactively identify insights, anomalies and optimization opportunities through continuous data analysis, supporting HQ and local stakeholders in strategic decisions.
* Work closely with the Digital Technologist to ensure correct media campaign tracking configuration (UTMs, events, conversions), guaranteeing data accuracy and ROAS calculation.
* Support local markets in assessing the impact of media investments, recommending optimizations grounded in analytical evidence.

*CRO \& A/B Testing Platform Ownership*

* Independently manage the CRO and A/B testing platforms adopted by the company, becoming the internal reference for their use and evolution.
* Act as the testing evangelist across local markets, fostering a culture of experimentation for web experience and CRM campaign development, while supporting teams in the design, execution, and analysis of testing activities.
* Develop deep expertise on the platforms in use, staying up to date with new features and industry best practices.
* Support vendor relationships for CRO platforms: handle commercial and support interactions, renewal negotiations and technical liaison.
* Manage platform user administration: access provisioning, role assignment and onboarding of new internal users and local market teams.
* Coordinate and operationally support local markets in the setup, launch and analysis of A/B testing and personalization experiments, ensuring sound methodologies and interpretable results.
* Monitor active experiments on a daily basis, flag anomalies and produce result summaries to support UX optimization decisions.
* Collaborate with UX, DTC Managers, Local Digital Marketing teams to define the experimentation roadmap, prioritizing tests based on potential impact and technical feasibility.

*Web Performance \& UX Optimization*

* Analyze navigation funnels and engagement metrics to identify friction points and propose user experience optimization solutions.
* Assess the impact of organic and paid traffic on website performance, contributing to UX reviews with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Support SEO and Media teams with impact analysis of their activities, providing data and analytical readings to inform their strategies.
* Contribute to defining shared measurement and tracking standards across HQ and local markets, ensuring data consistency and quality.

**What you need to succeed**

***Technical Skills***

* Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\): advanced navigation, segment creation, exploration funnels, custom events and attribution.
* Hands\-on experience with CRO activites and A/B testing platforms (e.g. AB Tasty, VWO, Optimizely, or equivalent).
* Ability to build reports and dashboards in BI tools (e.g. Looker Studio, Power BI or equivalent).
* Understanding of how the main digital channels work (SEO, Paid Search, Paid Social, Email) and their impact on analytics data.
* Knowledge of digital CRM logic and customer journey data.
* Familiarity with web performance metrics (Core Web Vitals, page load speed, etc.) and technical analysis tools (e.g. Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights).
* Good command of English (C1 level or above), required for communication with international stakeholders and vendor management.
* Knowledge of heatmap and session recording tools (e.g. Hotjar, Contentsquare, Microsoft Clarity).
* Familiarity with the fundamentals of UX Research and User Testing.

***Soft Skills***

* Strong data and measurement orientation: you don't stop at the number — you look for the why.
* Ability to listen to and manage requests from multiple stakeholders with competing priorities.
* Proactive attitude and operational independence: you are able to manage tools and processes on your own without waiting to be told how.
* Excellent communication skills: you can translate complex data into clear messages for non\-technical audiences.
* Structured approach and attention to detail, even in multi\-market contexts with high variability.
* Collaborative mindset and cross\-functional teamwork orientation.

**Employment Type:** Fixed\-term Contract; Full\-Time

**Minimum Gross Annual Salary:** € 30\.000

**Benefits**:

* Meal tickets
* Smart Working
